A_unexpectedUserIdentityTrace.reasonItAppears: App.tsx sub-header ribbon and Sidebar role drawer bind directly to navigationService.getRoleProfile(currentRole).userNameAr instead of reading activeAuthContext.displayName or userProfile.fullName.
A_unexpectedUserIdentityTrace.signedInUserDiscrepancy: Components consuming Firebase Auth (e.g., AuthButton, AccountStatusGate, MasterDataView) read user.displayName or userProfile.fullName correctly. However, header/sidebar navigation components display the role simulator's static profile string (ROLE_PROFILES[currentRole].userNameAr), leading to a dual identity display.

J_exactCleanupCandidates.evidence: Header ribbon in App.tsx displays 'المهندس / عبد الرحمن السعدون (مدير العمليات العام)' even when signed in as a different authenticated user.
J_exactCleanupCandidates.recommendation: MANUAL REVIEW — Update App.tsx header ribbon to use activeAuthContext.displayName / userProfile.fullName with fallback to role title.

J_exactCleanupCandidates.evidence: Contains static profiles with hardcoded names ('عبد الرحمن السعدون', 'فهد الشمري', 'خالد القحطاني', 'تركي الدوسري').
J_exactCleanupCandidates.recommendation: KEEP TEST-ONLY — Used in test suites and security simulator dropdown.

J_exactCleanupCandidates.evidence: ProjectSetupWizard initializes wizardData with mockTemplateData, causing 'PRJ-NEOM-WEST-01', 4 materials, 3 carriers, 3 pricing rules, and 4 users to be pre-filled when creating a new project.
J_exactCleanupCandidates.recommendation: MOVE TO EXPLICIT DEMO MODE — Provide a 'Fill Template Data' button in the wizard while initializing new projects with a clean empty state.

J_exactCleanupCandidates.evidence: Initializes ExceptionEngineService with 4 seed exceptions (EXP-2026-001 through 004).
J_exactCleanupCandidates.recommendation: MOVE TO EXPLICIT DEMO MODE — Load seed exceptions on demand or when running test suites.

J_exactCleanupCandidates.evidence: ImportCenterView initializes activeBatch with createInitialSampleBatch() on component mount.
J_exactCleanupCandidates.recommendation: MOVE TO EXPLICIT DEMO MODE — Allow users to load sample batches via a 'Load Sample CSV' button while keeping initial view clean.

J_exactCleanupCandidates.evidence: Used as fallback when Firestore returns empty collections for a project.
